desc: The X-Bolt 2 Speed features a Vari-Tech composite stock with Browning OVIX Camo finish and is adjustable for length of pull, comb height and grip angle for a personalized fit to the rifle; 1-1/4" Inflex Recoil Pad; X-Lock Scope Mounting System; redesigned receiver and bolt; threaded, fluted sporter-weight barrel with radial muzzle brake and Cerakote finish.
